en.headline: Rooftop Moonlit Market opens in Lai Chi Kok for Mid-Autumn weekend
en.dek: The Hive Lai Chi Kok hosts a free-entry family-friendly market with local food, crafts, workshops and carnival games on Saturday afternoon and evening.
body: A rooftop market celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival opens on Saturday at The Hive Lai Chi Kok, offering local bites, handmade crafts, live music and family activities under the early festival lights.

The event runs from 2pm to 8pm on 19 September at the 13th floor of the Tai Cheong (Liberal) Factory Building on Wing Ming Street in Cheung Sha Wan. Entry to the marketplace is free with advance ticket reservation, while carnival games and workshops carry separate charges.

Organisers said the line-up includes charm bracelet workshops, lip stain and gloss classes, sound baths with journaling, and carnival booths with a lucky draw for prizes such as a portable photo printer and a mini popcorn machine. Children and pets are welcome.
The market forms part of the wider Mid-Autumn programme across the city as the full moon approaches on 25 September.

zh.headline: 荔枝角天台月光市集周末登場 迎中秋
zh.dek: The Hive荔枝角今日下午至晚上舉辦親子友善市集，有本地美食、手工藝、工作坊及嘉年華遊戲，入場免費但需預先登記。
body: 荔枝角The Hive今日（9月19日）舉行天台月光市集，迎接中秋節氣氛，現場設本地小食、手工藝品、現場音樂及適合家庭的活動。
活動於長沙灣永明街大昌（自由）工廠大廈13樓舉行，時間由下午2時至晚上8時。市集入場免費，但需預先登記門票；嘉年華遊戲及工作坊則另行收費。
主辦單位表示，當日有手鏈工作坊、唇膏及唇彩製作班、聲音浴與日記工作坊，以及嘉年華攤位，參加者可抽獎贏取便攜相片打印機及迷你爆谷機等獎品。活動歡迎兒童及寵物參與。
市集是本港一連串中秋慶祝活動的一部分，正日為9月25日。
